blocks.text: This article describes how to edit an App Connector group. To learn about configuring an App Connector group and the available options, see About App Connector Groups or Configuring a Version Profile.
To edit a configured App Connector group:

blocks.item: Go to Private Access > Private Infrastructure > App Connector Groups.
In the table, locate the App Connector group you want to modify and click the Edit icon.
App Connector groups that are managed by Zscaler are read only and cannot be edited.

blocks.text: The Edit App Connector Group page appears.

blocks.item: In the Edit App Connector Group page, you can modify any field.
